Empecé por el cuarto del muchacho —la cama, la ropa, el espejo y hasta la montaña de zapatos debajo de la cama— y terminé en la cocina, con la grasa más brava que se ve en las casas viejas: los quemadores, el mesón y hasta el marco de la puerta escurriendo mugre. Poco a poco todo fue quedando como nuevo. Y lo más bonito: el señor, con lo desordenado que es, adora a su gatico, y tiene cuatro hijos que llegaron a acompañarlo. CH.title: Capturing the moor with Ffern. As the moorland turns to shifting shades of purple and the grasses return to richness after the summer, the sheep's milk becomes especially sweet and creamy - perfect for making a butter infused with the flowering tops of ling heather. I steeped the delicately fragrant heather tops in fresh milk, before separating the cream and churning it into smooth, golden butter. This butter brings together all the subtle flavours of autumn on the moor: the richness of the sheep's milk, the peaty mountain water, and the earthy fragrance of purple-painted hillsides. Ffern's AU26 fragrance is a celebration of the lengthening hours of soft light as the evenings begin to draw in. A song of texture, scent and the wild lands that sustain us.
CH.author: Charlotte

GLOBAL.title: Capturing the moor with Ffern. As the moorland turns to shifting shades of purple and the grasses return to richness after the summer, the sheep's milk becomes especially sweet and creamy - perfect for making a butter infused with the flowering tops of ling heather. I steeped the delicately fragrant heather tops in fresh milk, before separating the cream and churning it into smooth, golden butter. This butter brings together all the subtle flavours of autumn on the moor: the richness of the sheep's milk, the peaty mountain water, and the earthy fragrance of purple-painted hillsides. Ffern's AU26 fragrance is a celebration of the lengthening hours of soft light as the evenings begin to draw in. A song of texture, scent and the wild lands that sustain us.
